name: Duotone stock cluster
description: People photos in blue duotone with one colour photo among them.

recipe.build: mix-blend-mode:multiply over a blue gradient, or a filter stack; a cluster of tilted cards.

use_when: A generic teams or people beat that must sit inside the brand colour.
avoid: Do not hold longer than about 2 s; never as the only image of the film.

code.example: RasanMoves.duotoneStockCluster(tl, 0.2, { target: stage, images: [photo, photo2, photo3], colourIndex: 3 });
